title: AI结构性变革速览：空间算力部署、训练‑免费模型迁移与资本供应链双重挑战
core_insight: AI算力向空间延伸与训练‑免费模型迁移双重突破，导致算力部署与模型成本出现结构性下降，同时伴随融资压力与芯片供应链风险。

dimension_texts.technology: 暂无新SOTA模型发布，但LRMoE论文展示了在内存受限节点上训练大规模MoE模型的能力提升，拓宽了大模型在边缘设备上的适用范围；近期论文显示LLM在鲁棒性（Prompt‑agnostic LLM）、推理能力（Supervised Fine‑Tuning for Reasoning Survey）以及潜在修辞方向（From Geometry to Behavior）上取得渐进提升。 提出了面向内存受限环境的稀疏MoE训练方法（LRMoE）以及Moment‑Guided Optimizer等新型训练优化策略，标志着训练效率和鲁棒性的新范式；出现训练‑免费模型迁移的Artifact Distillation，以及可微分谓词量化的Predicate Neuron，标志着新范式的萌芽。 LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning Prompt-agnostic Language Models Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey
